entries.title: Release creation denied
entries.root_cause: The workflow token has contents read access but needs contents write access to create a GitHub release.

entries.title: Release creation denied again
entries.root_cause: The workflow token has contents read access but needs contents write access to create a GitHub release.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later tag and runner execute a different release command after packaging a different artifact.

entries.title: Pull request comment denied
entries.root_cause: The workflow token lacks pull-requests write access required to post a pull request comment; contents write access would not grant it.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same gh permission error occurs while creating a pull request comment, which requires pull-requests write rather than contents write.

entries.title: Release notes file absent
entries.root_cause: The release command points to a notes file at a path that does not exist in the checkout.
